guardrails.rule: SourceImagePackage is not a training dataset.
SourceImagePackage cannot bypass correction or review queue.
Manifest paths and manifest relative paths are references; only operator-selected files can become BrowserArtifactResource values.
TemplateProductionBatch is local admin workflow state and cannot persist object URLs, local absolute paths, large image bytes, or React state.
Production task publish requires explicit local confirmation and is not online publication.
TemplatePublishPackage is local export metadata, not backend publication, and cannot contain object URLs, local absolute paths, large image bytes, or React state.
src/engine, src/runtime, and src/intelligence/runtime are legacy frozen areas for new mainline work and cannot expand.
UserAppTemplatePackage is a local/export consumption contract, not the real user app and not online publication.
UserAppPrototypeConsumer is read-only admin validation, not the real user app, backend publication, online release, or training input.
UserAppTemplatePackage must remain stable through local JSON round-trip before Phase 7A shell consumption.
Phase 7A may build only a contract-driven local MVP shell and must not add backend, online publication, AR, training, native iOS scope, or unapproved runtime dependencies.
User App Shell must consume UserAppTemplatePackage only and cannot read SourceImagePackage directly.
Phase 7B may harden guidance UX only and must not add backend, database, login, camera, AR, training, native iOS, online publication, or unapproved runtime dependencies.
User-friendly warning and blocked messages explain readiness only; they do not repair invalid UserAppTemplatePackage data or bypass app contract validation.

Phase 7C may define user photo intake and personalization placeholders only and must not add real camera capture, AR, backend, database, training, native iOS, online publication, or unapproved runtime dependencies.
Phase 7C must not capture, upload, preview, analyze, store, export, or train on real user photos.
Phase 7C must not call browser camera APIs, request camera permissions, or render a real camera flow.
User photo bytes, imageBytes, photoBytes, data:image strings, and base64 image-like strings cannot be stored in shell state, durable export, project-state, or training inputs.
User photo data and user photo placeholder state cannot become training input or training dataset material.
Personalization is non-sensitive placeholder display hints only and cannot mutate templates, export user profiles, or create training data.
Phase 7D preferences are local-only shell state and cannot become backend sync, cloud sync, account profile data, durable export data, project-state user records, or training input.
Phase 7D onboarding is local-only shell state and cannot become account onboarding, backend sync, cloud sync, analytics, database persistence, or training input.
Local preferences cannot contain health information, sensitive identity fields, precise personal identity fields, photos, face embeddings, biometric identifiers, or other sensitive profile data.
Local preferences and onboarding state cannot become training input, training dataset material, model artifacts, or evaluation data.
Preferences can affect guidance hints only and cannot mutate UserAppTemplatePackage, UserAppTemplate, makeup steps, region instructions, tools, products, compatibility, or lineage.
Phase 7E recommendation is a placeholder only and must not be treated as real AI recommendation, backend personalization, analytics, advertising, ecommerce, or a user profile system.
Recommendation placeholder behavior must remain local-only shell behavior and cannot sync to backend, cloud, database, account systems, analytics, or durable user profile storage.
Recommendation ranking must remain deterministic, rule-based, and explainable from UserAppTemplatePackage metadata plus non-sensitive local preferences.
Phase 7E recommendation must not call OpenAI, external AI/CV APIs, external recommendation APIs, or remote personalization services.

Discovery filters and recommendations can affect display order and reasons only; they cannot mutate UserAppTemplatePackage, UserAppTemplate, steps, regions, tools, products, compatibility, or lineage.

Phase 7F session persistence is local-only shell behavior and cannot become account storage, backend session sync, cloud sync, database persistence, analytics, production app storage, or cross-device sync.
Phase 7F must not add login, accounts, identity, user profile services, or account onboarding.
User App session state cannot sync to backend services or remote session APIs.
User App session payloads cannot store object URLs or blob: runtime references.
Session save, load, recovery, and reconciliation can affect local UI state only and cannot mutate UserAppTemplatePackage.
Phase 7G app readiness gate is required before treating the local User App Shell as ready for app prototype QA, but it is not production release approval.
Mobile interaction QA is required before browser/device QA work and must remain deterministic, local-only checklist readiness.
Readiness gate reports do not create a production app, native iOS app, backend readiness, app store readiness, or online release approval.
Phase 7G readiness and mobile QA must not add backend services, database storage, account systems, cloud sync, analytics, or remote persistence.
Phase 7G readiness and mobile QA must not add real camera capture, upload, file input, face analysis, or user photo collection.
Phase 7G readiness and mobile QA must not add AR behavior or AR runtime state.
Phase 7G readiness and mobile QA must not create training input, training datasets, model artifacts, or evaluation data.
Phase 7G and Phase 7H must not add new runtime dependencies without explicit approval.
Readiness and mobile QA can read UserAppTemplatePackage-derived view models only and cannot mutate UserAppTemplatePackage.

Phase 7H browser/mobile QA is local deterministic prototype QA only and is not production release approval, real device lab QA, native iOS QA, backend readiness, camera readiness, AR readiness, training readiness, or app store readiness.

Phase 7H browser/mobile QA must not add backend, database, accounts, cloud sync, analytics, camera, AR, training, OpenAI API, external API calls, native iOS scope, online publication, or new runtime dependencies.

project-state may document Phase 7H boundaries and validation status, but cannot store real user browser QA records, readiness records, session records, preference records, recommendation records, profile values, or photo data.

Phase 7H browser/mobile QA reports cannot persist photos, temporary image URLs, local paths, encoded image data, image/photo bytes, biometrics, sensitive profile fields, React state, recommendation records, readiness records, browser QA records, or training input.
Use docs/skills/PROJECT_RECOVERY_SKILL.md for recovery handoffs and repository-state restoration.
Use docs/skills/PHASE_EXECUTION_SKILL.md for phase execution with scoped implementation, validation, and handoff updates.
Use docs/skills/CONTRACT_SCHEMA_GUARD_SKILL.md when contract, schema, export, import, or durable data boundaries change.
Use docs/skills/COMPACT_HANDOFF_SKILL.md and compact handoff by default unless the user explicitly asks for a full prompt.
Do not paste full repository directory trees or generated dependency trees such as node_modules into prompts, handoffs, or status documents.
Do not repeatedly paste full phase history when a compact phase summary or repository source-of-truth reference is sufficient.
Prefer compact reports that point to repository files instead of duplicating full docs, dist, .test-dist, .vite, coverage, or generated outputs.
Repository files are the source of truth; chat history is not. Prefer START_HERE.md, docs/status, docs/prompts, and project-state files as context.
Provide a full prompt only when the user explicitly requests it; otherwise provide compact prompt or medium prompt context.
External skills must be listed in project-state/external-skills-registry.json before they are used.
External skills default to explicit-only invocation; candidate skills cannot be invoked implicitly.
External skill scripts are disabled by default and require manual review before any use.
External skills must not install production dependencies without explicit approval.
External skills must not override AGENTS.md, project skills, MASTER_CODEX_CONTEXT.md, or project-state guardrails.
Repository root AGENTS.md is required as the short agent entry point for source-of-truth, validation, compact handoff, and external skill rules.
Phase 8A is product route and ownership planning only; it must not implement the production user app.

Phase 8A selects React Web / PWA MVP first, but that decision is not a Web app implementation, deployment, backend, analytics surface, online release, native implementation, camera flow, AR flow, ecommerce/community/paid scope, OpenAI API, external API, training phase, or app store release approval.
Future production user-facing app work must be planned as a separate app surface or repository after an explicit phase gate; Makeup Engine remains the template production system.
UserAppTemplatePackage remains the handoff contract and route planning cannot mutate package data, templates, shell state, training data, or project-state user records.

Phase 8A must not add backend, database, accounts, analytics, camera, AR, OpenAI API, external API, training, native iOS implementation, online publication, production app code, or new runtime dependencies.
Phase 8A must not add React Native, Flutter, iOS native, ecommerce, community, paid features, app store release work, TestFlight work, real photo capture, or model training.
SourceImagePackage cannot directly enter the future User App; the future MVP must consume validated UserAppTemplatePackage exports only.
Phase 8B PWA/mobile polish is local shell polish only and is not production PWA release approval.
Phase 8B may add lightweight manifest metadata, theme color, icon placeholder, PWA readiness, MVP polish readiness, and mobile UI polish only.

Phase 8B must not add service worker, offline cache, push notification, background sync, install tracking, analytics, backend, database, accounts, cloud sync, camera, AR, native app, online publication, app store release work, external APIs, training, or new runtime dependencies.
PWA readiness, MVP polish readiness, app readiness, mobile QA, and interaction checklist panels are administrator QA surfaces, not ordinary user production features.
Phase 8B shell polish, readiness, QA, sessions, preferences, and recommendations cannot mutate UserAppTemplatePackage, write real user records into project-state, or enter training datasets.

Phase 8C trial pack is local internal / small-scope trial planning only and is not production release, App Store/TestFlight, backend form, analytics, camera, AR, training, online publication, or real user data collection approval.

Phase 8C feedback must not collect real names, contact information, photos, health information, sensitive identity information, face embeddings, biometric identifiers, backend records, analytics records, or training data.
Phase 8C trial tasks, feedback, readiness, sessions, preferences, recommendations, and admin panels cannot write real user trial records into project-state or training datasets.
Phase 8C trial tasks, feedback, readiness, sessions, preferences, recommendations, and admin panels cannot mutate UserAppTemplatePackage.

Phase 8D template content QA, trial template selection, and trial content readiness are local content QA only and are not production release, App Store/TestFlight, backend, analytics, AI generation, OpenAI/external API, camera, AR, or training approval.
Phase 8D content QA reports cannot mutate UserAppTemplatePackage, templates, trial tasks, sessions, preferences, recommendations, or admin panels.

Phase 8D content QA cannot collect photos, names, contacts, health information, sensitive identity information, biometrics, backend records, analytics records, real user trial records, or training data.
Phase 8D must not call OpenAI, external AI/CV APIs, external recommendation APIs, or generate template content through remote services.

Phase 8E MVP release readiness and trial go/no-go are local gate decisions for internal small-scope trial preparation only and are not production release, App Store/TestFlight, backend, analytics, camera, AR, AI generation, external API, or training approval.

Phase 8E go_for_internal_trial or go_with_warnings means internal trial preparation can proceed; it does not mean the app is production-ready, publicly released, App Store/TestFlight-ready, or online-published.

Phase 8E must not add backend, database, accounts, analytics, service worker, offline cache, push notification, background sync, install tracking, camera, AR, external API calls, OpenAI API calls, training, or real user data collection.

Phase 8E release readiness, go/no-go, feedback, sessions, preferences, recommendations, content QA, and admin panels cannot mutate UserAppTemplatePackage, write real user records into project-state, or enter training datasets.

Phase 9A internal trial operations, observation templates, and outcome review are local administrator preparation only and are not public recruitment, production release, App Store/TestFlight, backend forms, analytics, camera, AR, AI analysis, external API, or training approval.

Phase 9A participant coverage uses broad participant types only and cannot collect real names, contact information, health information, sensitive identity information, photos, face embeddings, biometric identifiers, backend records, analytics records, or training data.

Phase 9A must not add backend, database, accounts, analytics, service worker, offline cache, push notification, background sync, install tracking, camera, AR, external API calls, OpenAI API calls, AI analysis, training, or real user data collection.

Phase 9A operations, observation, outcome review, feedback, sessions, preferences, recommendations, content QA, and admin panels cannot mutate UserAppTemplatePackage, write real user records into project-state, or enter training datasets.

Phase 9B internal trial result review, issue taxonomy, and decision framework are local administrator review aids only and are not production analytics, public recruitment, production release, App Store/TestFlight, backend forms, analytics, camera, AR, AI analysis, OpenAI/external API usage, or training approval.

Phase 9B review signals are anonymous/mock/example summaries only and cannot collect real names, contact information, health information, sensitive identity information, photos, face embeddings, biometric identifiers, backend records, analytics records, or training data.
Phase 9B must not add backend, database, account system, cloud sync, analytics, AI analysis, OpenAI/external API usage, camera, AR, native app scope, online publication, or new runtime dependencies.
Phase 9B result review, issue taxonomy, and decision framework cannot write real user records into project-state, enter training datasets, or mutate UserAppTemplatePackage.

Phase 9C internal trial iteration plan, backlog, and priority framework are local administrator planning aids only and must not become a formal production roadmap, backend issue tracker, production analytics, or production release approval.

Phase 9C iteration inputs are anonymous/mock/example summaries only and cannot collect real names, contact information, health information, sensitive identity information, photos, face embeddings, biometric identifiers, backend records, analytics records, AI analysis records, or training data.
Phase 9C must not add backend, database, accounts, cloud sync, analytics, camera, AR, AI analysis, OpenAI/external API usage, online publication, App Store/TestFlight, or new runtime dependencies.

Phase 9C iteration plan, backlog, priority framework, sessions, preferences, recommendations, and admin panels cannot mutate UserAppTemplatePackage, write real user records into project-state, or enter training datasets.
Phase 9D learning summary and product decision gate are local decision aids only, not production analytics or production app approval.
Phase 9D inputs must not collect real names, contacts, photos, health information, sensitive identity information, or biometrics.
Phase 9D must not add backend records, analytics, AI analysis, OpenAI/external API calls, camera, AR, or production runtime collection.
Phase 9D must not write training data or real user trial records into project-state.

Phase 9E evidence pack, summary, and sufficiency gate are local administrator evidence aids only, not production analytics, public recruitment, backend collection, AI analysis, training, production app approval, or production release approval.

Phase 9E evidence cannot collect or store real names, contact information, photos, health information, sensitive identity information, face embeddings, biometric identifiers, backend records, analytics records, AI analysis records, or training data.

Phase 9E must not add backend, database, accounts, analytics, AI analysis, OpenAI/external API usage, camera, AR, upload, service worker, offline cache, push notification, background sync, install tracking, native app, or production runtime collection.
Phase 9E evidence cannot write training input or real user trial records into project-state and cannot mutate UserAppTemplatePackage.
